query: UPDATE job_item ji SET state = 'queued', blocked_on = NULL, park_expires_at = NULL WHERE ji.org_id = $1 AND ji.mapping_id = $2 AND ji.state = 'parked_live' AND ji.blocked_on = $3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job j WHERE j.org_id = ji.org_id AND j.id = ji.job_id AND j.deletion_requested_at IS NOT NULL) RETURNING ji.org_id, ji.job_id, ji.id
